subquestions.text_open: 9-1-1 In radical reactions of allylic compounds using NBS or HBr, substitution and addition compete, and different reagents show different selectivities. Write the major products of the following two reactions.

text_images.description: Two organic reaction schemes. In the first, 'CC1(C)C=CCCC1' reacts with NBS under irradiation. In the second, 'CC(C1CCCCC1)=C' reacts with HBr and $\mathrm{(BzO)_2}$.

rubric: 'CC1(C)C=C[C@@H](Br)CC1', as a racemate (±) (2 points: 1 point for the skeleton and 1 point for stereochemistry); 'C[C@](CBr)([H])C1CCCCC1', as a racemate (±) (2 points: 1 point for the skeleton and 1 point for stereochemistry).

rubric_images.description: Organic structural formula with the SMILES 'CC1(C)C=C[C@@H](Br)CC1', shown as a racemate (±).
Organic structural formula with the SMILES 'C[C@](CBr)([H])C1CCCCC1', shown as a racemate (±).

subquestions.text_open: 9-2-1 Radical reactions can also achieve efficient intramolecular N-C bond coupling. Write the key intermediates in the following reaction.

text_images.description: Organic reaction scheme in which 'C1(CN2CCCCC2)NCCCC1' reacts with NCS under irradiation to give 'N12CCCCC1CN3C2CCCC3'.

rubric: The SMILES strings of the key intermediates are 'ClN1CCCCC1CN2CCCCC2', 'C5(CN6CCCCC6)[N]CCCC5', 'C7(CN8[C]CCCC8)NCCCC7', 'ClC(CCCC3)N3CC4NCCCC4', and 'C9(C[N+]%10=CCCCC%10)NCCCC9' (1 point each, 5 points total).

rubric_images.description: Five organic structural formulas with the SMILES strings 'ClN1CCCCC1CN2CCCCC2', 'C5(CN6CCCCC6)[N]CCCC5', 'C7(CN8[C]CCCC8)NCCCC7', 'ClC(CCCC3)N3CC4NCCCC4', and 'C9(C[N+]%10=CCCCC%10)NCCCC9'.

subquestions.text_open: 9-3-4 The following reaction undergoes efficient triethylborane-catalyzed cyclization to give two isomers, A1 and A2, of which A2 is the major product. Write the SMILES string of A2 and those of the key intermediates leading to A2.

text_images.description: Organic reaction scheme in which 'CC1(C)C(O1)/C=C/CCCC#C' reacts with triethylborane and triphenyltin hydride in benzene to give A1, 'OC(C)(C)/C=C/C(CCC/1)C1=C[Sn](C2=CC=CC=C2)(C3=CC=CC=C3)C4=CC=CC=C4', and A2.

rubric: A2: 'OC(C)(C)/C=C/C1=C(C[Sn](C2=CC=CC=C2)(C3=CC=CC=C3)C4=CC=CC=C4)CCC1' (2 points). Intermediates: 'CC1(C)C(O1)/C=C/CCC/[C]=C[Sn](C2=CC=CC=C2)(C3=CC=CC=C3)C4=CC=CC=C4', 'CC5C(O5)[C]C(CCC/6)C6=C[Sn](C7=CC=CC=C7)(C8=CC=CC=C8)C9=CC=CC=C9', '[O]C(C)(C)/C=C/C(CCC/%10)C%10=C[Sn](C%11=CC=CC=C%11)(C%12=CC=CC=C%12)C%13=CC=CC=C%13', and 'OC(C)(C)/C=C/[C](CCC/%14)C%14=C[Sn](C%15=CC=CC=C%15)(C%16=CC=CC=C%16)C%17=CC=CC=C%17' (2 points each, 8 points total; a reasonable resonance form of the last intermediate is accepted).

rubric_images.description: A2 and 4 key intermediates. A2 is 'OC(C)(C)/C=C/C1=C(C[Sn](C2=CC=CC=C2)(C3=CC=CC=C3)C4=CC=CC=C4)CCC1'. In sequence, the intermediates are 'CC1(C)C(O1)/C=C/CCC/[C]=C[Sn](C2=CC=CC=C2)(C3=CC=CC=C3)C4=CC=CC=C4', 'CC5C(O5)[C]C(CCC/6)C6=C[Sn](C7=CC=CC=C7)(C8=CC=CC=C8)C9=CC=CC=C9', '[O]C(C)(C)/C=C/C(CCC/%10)C%10=C[Sn](C%11=CC=CC=C%11)(C%12=CC=CC=C%12)C%13=CC=CC=C%13', and 'OC(C)(C)/C=C/[C](CCC/%14)C%14=C[Sn](C%15=CC=CC=C%15)(C%16=CC=CC=C%16)C%17=CC=CC=C%17'.
